title: Be the robot: one step at a time
source: T1 L1 facilitator card (Teach and Unplugged stations)
status: DRAFT. Hints adapted from the facilitator card wording. Need a teacher check. Sesotho fields are empty until a Sesotho speaker has written them.

done.en: Well done. Tell your partner how you know your robot ends on the right square.

exercises.title: Walk to the water tank
exercises.prompt: Thuso starts on the Gate (A1) facing North. Build a route that ends on the Water tank (C3). Use Forward, Turn Left and Turn Right. Use 5 cards or fewer.

exercises.title: Walk to C2
exercises.prompt: Thuso starts on A1 facing North. Build a route that ends on C2. Use 4 cards or fewer.

exercises.title: Straight up
exercises.prompt: Thuso starts on A1 facing North. Build a route that ends on A4 using only Forward cards.

turn_moves.desc: Thinks a turn moves the robot to a new square.
en: Look at your Turn card. After a turn, did the robot move to a new square?
Walk your cards on the grid and put a finger on the cap after each card. Which cards moved it?
A turn spins the robot on the spot. It stays on the same square. Only Forward moves it to a new square.

lr_swapped.desc: Mixes up the robot's left and right.
en: Stand behind the robot so left and right match. Which way does your turn card send it?
The robot's right, not yours. Face the same way as the robot and try the turn again.
Check each turn card. Would the other turn card keep the robot on the path?

stopped_short.desc: Route stops one square before the goal.
en: Your robot ends on {end}. The goal is {target}. Walk your cards again, one at a time.
Count the squares the robot steps ON, not the one it starts on.
Your route stops before the goal. Is there a Forward you can add?

went_too_far.desc: Route goes one square past the goal.
en: Your robot ends on {end}, past the goal. Walk your cards again, one at a time.
Count the squares the robot steps ON. Where should it stop?
Your route goes one step too far. Is there a Forward you can take away?
Your robot walked off the grid. Walk your cards with a finger and say each one.
After each turn, which way is the robot facing now? Say it out loud.
Find the card where the robot leaves the grid. Which way was it facing just before?

too_long.desc: Route works but uses more cards than needed.
en: Your robot reaches the goal. Well done. Can you do it with fewer cards?
Which cards could you take away and still reach {target}?
Where does the path bend? A route with one turn in it can be shorter.
Your robot ends on {end}. The goal is {target}.
Say the first step out loud. What comes next?
Walk the route on the grid. Where does the path bend, and what did the robot do there?
Your robot is on the right square. Which way is it facing?
The goal says which way the robot must face. Check your last card.
Walk your route and say the way the robot faces after every card.

generic.desc: Any answer the coach cannot place.
en: Try again slowly. What does the exercise ask you to do first?
Say the first step out loud. What comes next?
Ask your partner what they think. If you are still stuck, ask your facilitator.
